content.summary: Fintech mortgage provider Rocket Companies (NYSE:RKT) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 21.3% year on year to $1.61 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s outlook exceeded expectations with revenue guided to $2.2 billion at the midpoint, or 4.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.07 per share was 46.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
